newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ's Bolger says coalition chances still 50-50.
newsitem.headline: NZ's Bolger says coalition chances still 50-50.

text.p: New Zealand caretaker Prime Minister Jim Bolger on Wednesday said the chances of New Zealand First forming a coalition were still "50-50" between his National Party and Labour.
Bolger declined further comment to reporters after a meeting of National MPs.

He said an announcement would be made in due course about when parliament would meet for the first time since October elections which left nationalist NZ First holding the balance of power. Parliament must convene by December 13.
